extensionDescription.message: Fill the YouTube tab with a centered cover crop while keeping the browser chrome visible.

optionsTagline.message: Centered cover mode for YouTube videos.

shortcutHelp.message: Default: º, the key left of 1 on Spanish keyboards. On other layouts, record a YouTube-only shortcut here.

statusInvalid.message: Press a normal key or a combination with Ctrl, Alt or Shift.

shortcutGlobalHelp.message: The recorder changes only the YouTube tab shortcut. For a system-wide shortcut, set the browser command to Global in chrome://extensions/shortcuts or brave://extensions/shortcuts.

statusUnreliable.message: Saved: $SHORTCUT$. This shortcut may be reserved by the browser, so it might not reach YouTube.
